name: omp-vcc
description: Algorithmic VCC compaction for omp - fast lossless no-LLM
author: Zhu Lin <zhulin@czl.my>

omp.description: Algorithmic VCC compaction for omp - fast lossless no-LLM

overrideDefaultCompaction.description: When true, omp-vcc handles all compactions (threshold/overflow/manual); when false, only /omp-vcc is handled

smartKeepTail.description: Boost default keep:1 tail when small (5k→25k token window)

chainShakeHint.description: Eager post-VCC shake chain (host rescue is automatic; this forces a second shake even when VCC created headroom)
